notes: Andrew, 2026-11-10, with a screenshot of an Amazon listing (a camel chenille bench at the foot of a bed, on a pale gray-ivory rug that runs under the lower part of the bed): "I want an end of bed ottoman and a rug in the style here (i.e. coving a part of the end of the bed and the ottoman). Be mindful: radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed. show me layout in browser. Use amazon only for searches. Be a interior designer, make sure color,lenght etc work" IKEA sells three RÅDMANSÖ dressers in brown walnut effect, all 18 7/8" deep: the 6-drawer (ikea-40593839, 62 5/8" wide, 31 7/8" tall, $349.99), the 3-drawer (ikea-80593837, 35 3/8" wide, 31 3/4" tall, $229.99) and the 5-drawer (ikea-60593838, 27 1/2" wide, 52" tall, $299.99). Which one Andrew means isn't said: the 6-drawer is staged, and the depth, which sets every clearance in front of it, is the same for all three. IKEA was opened only to read these (his words: "Use amazon only for searches"). Not staged: if this is the one, it takes the 6-drawer's place centered on the same line (y 48.625-84), leaving 58 5/8" of the 94" of left wall between F-33's 6" off the heater and the door's swing. Article 805.938.37; 4.2 stars; the page says "Designed to meet the US Federal Stability Standard". In stock at IKEA Long Island, NY (as read). Flags: anchor-required (F-21: 31 3/4" tall).
